name: cognee-memory
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, built on Cognee's knowledge graph. Captures your prompts, tool calls and answers, recalls what's relevant on every prompt, and carries decisions and lessons into later sessions. Runs locally or on Cognee Cloud.

icon.title: Cognee logo
icon.description: Show the Cognee logo on the status row and on the credit line under answers. Set to none to hide it.

band.title: Status row above the prompt
band.description: Show Cognee's status row above the prompt: dataset picker, counters and current memory activity.

spinner.title: Show memory activity in the spinner
spinner.description: Add what Cognee is doing (recalling, saving, consolidating) after the spinner while Claude works.

tools.title: Give Claude direct memory tools
tools.description: Register search and remember as tools Claude can call directly (mcp__cognee-memory__search / remember) instead of going through a skill and a shell command.

tour.title: First-run tour
tour.description: On the first session on this machine, show three short hints under the status row about what it shows and does (/cognee-tour replays them).
